paragraphs: Rav Chisda’s student, as in [Sukkah 29a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.29a.1); Hyman identifies him as Rami bar Chama.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Hebrew reads (דרבה) bar Chama. The accompanying English gives Rava and Rami bar Chama studying before Rav Chisda.
Hyman identifies his headword with Rami bar Chama and calls him Rav Chisda’s student. The linked English supplies both names, where the corresponding Hebrew has the parenthesized form.
